note: A genuine attestation whose statement text holds the same members and values with typ first (not the order of RFC 8785), signed by O over the statement's canonical form, then a genuine attestation at 4: the statement is not its own canonical form. Statements are the exact output of CanonicalizeWithNfc, each signature is detached under curia-operator-act+jws with the key's thumbprint as the header kid; the keys the case publishes are its own log.operator-key, log.key and log.declaration-key entries. expected.json is written from this construction and never by running a verifier. A proposal: it may be regenerated until the owner's lift record pins its digests.
